_comment: WB YouTube Job Alert Agent — Master Settings. Edit this file to control all system behaviour.

modes._bootstrap_comment: Set true for the FIRST run only. Marks all current videos as seen WITHOUT sending alerts. Set false after the first run.
modes._test_comment: Set true to prepend 🧪 TEST to all Telegram messages. Use during verification.

confirmation._min_sources_comment: Minimum number of independent channels to confirm an event. 1 = alert immediately with confidence tag. 2 = wait for two sources.
confirmation._confidence_comment: AI confidence score above this value is treated as high-confidence even with a single source.

_soon_comment: If a video says application will open in this many days or fewer, classify as APPLICATION_OPEN_SOON.

source_priority._comment: Weights used for source display order and tie-breaking — never for factual truth.

telegram._polling_comment: How often telegram_commands.yml checks for button presses. 10 min recommended for public repos, 30 min for private.
telegram._admin_comment: YOUR personal chat ID where alerts are sent. Find using get_telegram_chat_id workflow.
telegram._channel_comment: Optional: HASAN ONLINE channel ID. Set auto_forward_to_channel=true when ready to publish publicly.

openrouter._model_comment: openrouter/auto selects the best available free model. You can pin a specific model here.
openrouter._budget_comment: Stop making AI calls if this many requests are used in a day (safety margin under 50/day free limit).

youtube._quota_comment: Warn and stop if daily quota approaches this (safety margin under 10,000/day).
youtube._max_videos_comment: Only check the N most recent videos per channel per run.

full_information._comment: Toggle which fields are extracted when EXTRACT FULL INFORMATION is pressed.
